source: Kervella et al. (2017), A&A 597, A137, Table 3, row Power: the power law limb darkened disc fitted to the VLTI/PIONIER squared visibilities of this star (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/201629505)
band: VLTI/PIONIER H band, 1.65 um; not a visible band
note: I(mu)/I(1) = mu^alpha, the paper's equation for its power law (Hestroffer 1997). Fitted with the angular diameter 8.502 mas, the diameter this package's radius comes from (reduced chi-squared 3.90). The paper finds this limb darkening weaker than 1D and 3D model atmospheres predict in the same band. The only measured limb of Alpha Centauri A; the visible limb is not measured.
